rubrics.justification: Describes an expanded/full blastocyst with thinned zona, compact ICM, and cohesive multicellular TE consistent with the reported high-grade blastocyst; notes possible transient collapse appropriately. Minor limitation is some uncertainty between 3AA and 4AA and reliance on image interpretation not fully verifiable here.

Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve markers, BMI, diagnosis, prior miscarriage, semen parameters, endometrial thickness, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis, including how low MII yield may affect future cycles rather than this embryo directly.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent: strong embryo morphology plus favorable patient factors support good prognosis, while untested status, prior miscarriage, and possible sperm/trigger issues appropriately temper estimates.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and aligned with IVF practice, including elective single embryo transfer, caution about overinterpreting one miscarriage, and selective rather than routine PGT-A at age 27. Minor deviation is some speculative discussion without full cycle data.

Provides clear next steps for current transfer and future planning, including SET, luteal support adherence, follow-up timing, review of trigger/maturity issues, possible sperm DNA fragmentation testing, uterine cavity assessment, and FET strategy considerations.
